_comment: Tier-2: the KratosFemToDemApplication wheel is stuck at 10.2.3 with no CPython-3.12 wheel, so it cannot be installed into a Python 3.12 / Kratos 10.4.x stack. Pitfall (kratos.fem_to_dem #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). import KratosMultiphysics.FemToDemApplication raises ModuleNotFoundError; pip reports no installable distribution for KratosFemToDemApplication on this interpreter. Its prerequisites DEMApplication and StructuralMechanicsApplication both import. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
